app.name: HIIT Coach
app.subtitle: Interval and endurance coaching built around you
app.localizedDescription:
HIIT Coach builds interval and endurance workouts around your equipment, your level and your time, guides you through them live, and steps the targets up as you get fitter.

• Treadmill, stationary bike or outdoors, with every target clamped to what your machine can do
• Research-based protocols: classic intervals, Norwegian 4×4, 10-20-30, pyramids, hill climbs
• Early warnings before each step up, spoken cues, and a Live Activity with lock-screen controls
• Live heart rate from any Bluetooth strap or an Apple Watch, with one-tap coaching suggestions
• Sessions graded against their training objectives, with history and trends
• Laid out for iPhone Duo: closed, open, and folded

No accounts, no subscriptions, no servers — everything stays on your phone.
